answer: Make each agent post a copper-grade refundable bond whose size grows quadratically with how many peers share its funding origin. A lone well-funded island of one pays a tiny fee, but a farm of 1000 clones drawn from one wallet pays roughly 1000x and is painted umber on the shared-provenance graph, where auditors slash the whole correlated cluster together. Honest cost stays linear in distinct real funders while sybil cost explodes superlinearly.
